system.description: The target takes the form of a hare and retains its Intelligence and traits compatible with this form. It can communicate with hares, see in darkness, and gains Dexterity +4 and Strength −2; its land movement is doubled. Attacks against it suffer −3 to their combat value. Its equipment merges into the animal form and returns to its original state when it changes back.
system.summary: Transforms into a hare, increases Dexterity and land movement, reduces Strength and penalizes incoming attacks.
